text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
It's Grass Wonder! Grass Wonder has
won the
Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That's the Beast's successor for you!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Even Maruzensky couldn't make this
dream a
reality!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder says nothing as the
acclaim
continues pouring in. She keeps
her head bowed
respectfully low.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During lunch a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, may I have a moment before we
begin
today's training session?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I have a gift for you. It's... nothing all too
special.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Just a small token of my appreciation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I didn't achieve the Triple Crown all on
my own.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I'm merely the one who's subject to the
public's
eye.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thus, I feel that the message should
come directly
from myself.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We won the Triple Crown. ♪ Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With that, she presents three small
winner's
sashes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, I thank you.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The Triple Crown is the highest honor
one can
achieve in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A dream the vast majority of
Umamusume will
never realize, no matter
how badly they may want
it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I feel that I can truly stand tall.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for making me a Triple Crown

champion.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No... I still have much to learn.
choice_data_list: ……君が自分の力で勝ち取ったものだ
……貴方が自分の力で勝ち取ったものだよ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder seems to be implying
something.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: If I may add something minor as well...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The defeated Umamusume aren't the
only ones
who couldn't realize their
Triple Crown dreams.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Many never get the chance to compete
at all, due
to various circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
The wall of "if only" that many
Umamusume run
into is unfathomably
high.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Which is why, now that I've received the
highest
of honors...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I fully comprehend the enormity of the
wall I must
clear.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Heh. That's why I'll fasten my helm on
tight and
strive to be even better
moving forward.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My determination holds strong. I hope
that yours
won't falter either.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I glimpse a burning blue flame within her
eyes
before it disappears behind her
serene smile.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Yep... Completely ignored once again.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh? Whatcha doing over here, Sei?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Nothing really.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
By the way, wanna hit up the shopping
district?
Maybe get some taiyaki,
sweets, or something?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ooh, that sounds nice!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: But also kind of sudden...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Meh... I need a distraction, and I figure
food'll do
the trick.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And with that, the Classic Triple Crown
ends on a
quiet note. The Japan Cup,
however, is right
around the corner.
